title: European Researchers’ Night
text: Bringing AI and healthcare closer to the public at European Researchers’ Night, with GAPS-UPM.
description: At European Researchers’ Night at ETSIT-UPM, GAPS ran the workshop “¿Puede una IA predecir tu salud?” (“Can AI predict your health?”). Through hands-on activities, participants explored how data can reveal patterns and support health predictions, while discussing the possibilities and limitations of AI in medicine.

text: Our study on oxygenscan parameters in sickle cell disease is out in Scientific Reports.
title: Oxygenscan parameters in sickle cell disease
description: Published in Scientific Reports, our study examines new oxygenscan parameters to better characterize red blood cell behavior across sickle cell disease genotypes.

text: SAMVAE, our work on multimodal survival analysis, is published in Scientific Reports.
title: SAMVAE: multimodal survival analysis
description: SAMVAE brings clinical, molecular and histopathological data together in a probabilistic framework for survival analysis, including competing risks. Our work is now published in Scientific Reports.

text: Our paper on interpretable machine learning for battery diagnostics is out in Battery Energy.
title: Interpretable machine learning for battery diagnostics
description: Our Battery Energy paper combines machine learning with in situ impedance spectra for interpretable diagnostics of solid-state batteries.
